svg.desc: A reliability diagram: the diagonal is perfect calibration; an under-confident model's curve lies above it and an over-confident model's curve below it. Beside it: temperature scaling divides logits by one scalar T fitted on validation; T below 1 sharpens, T above 1 softens, and the argmax and accuracy never change. In this notebook T was 0.59 and ECE fell from 0.124 to 0.034.
